subject: I-O status
notes: kb/Work PB1514 landed (w67p). cite.py --check 9.1.13.2 'A READ statement is successfully executed but the physical record from the file is shorter than or longer than the minimum or maximum length' -> OK §9.1.13.2 3). The VARYING leg was verified. The FIXED-length leg is now a documented determination (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-146 (a)): §9.1.7.2 ('the length of each record is determined by any information the implementor may add to the record on the physical storage medium', cite.py OK §9.1.7.2) - this format adds none, so a fixed file's physical record is the next integer-1 bytes of the READING description (GnuCOBOL's fixed-length format, CLAUDE.md rule 1). A physical record is then never longer than the maximum, and shorter only at the end of the file, which is the '04'. The golden io_status_04 is re-derived from that rule (it pinned the undefined §14.9.30.4 GR14 fill; it now shows only the bytes read, and adds a 15-byte record read as a 10-byte '00' record and a 5-byte '04' record).
